evidence.description: The master driver states that it runs the full pipeline and lists its five ordered processing/analysis parts.
evidence.quote:
# This master script operates the full data pipeline and analysis workflow
# for the "Partisan Cities" project, which examines how political alignment
# between city mayors and state governors affects municipal bond pricing,
# bond issuance, and intergovernmental transfers.
#
# The script executes R source files sequentially, clearing the environment
# (rm(list = ls())) and forcing garbage collection (gc()) after each step
# to manage memory usage across the pipeline.
#
# Pipeline overview:
#   Part 1: Clean auxiliary datasets (Census, single audits, credit ratings)
#   Part 2: Build primary municipal bond dataset from Mergent FISD
#   Part 3: Clean secondary market trading data from MSRB
#   Part 4: Construct city-level financial panel data
#   Part 5: Generate tables and figures (in order of appearance in paper)
#
# Note: Scripts must be run in order
